about: Every equation a registry value is derived or passed down by (registry/README.md): its formula, its inputs and output with their units, its source, and checks -- inputs and the value they give -- that both implementations (registry/equations.js, registry/equations.py) are tested on. A statistic over measurements (a median, a mean) is an equation too, its choice ours and said so.

string-density.formula: mu = T / (2 L f0)^2 (Mersenne: f0 = sqrt(T / mu) / 2L)

inharmonicity-at-open.formula: B = median(takes) / 2^(2 stopped / 12): a stopped note's B read at the open string's length (B goes as 1/L^2)

inputs.takes: B of each take, at the note played
inputs.stopped: semitones above the open string the takes were played at

inharmonicity-at-open.statistic: the median of the takes: ours

stiffness-from-inharmonicity.formula: EI = B T L^2 / pi^2 (B = pi^2 EI / (T L^2))

same.formula: x = value: a value taken as another's

elliptic-aperture-conductance.formula: C = 1 / (1 / (2 a AGM(1, b/a)) + t / (pi a b)): an elliptic aperture's conductance in a thin wall, semi-axes a over b (Rayleigh's pi a / K(e), K the complete elliptic integral of the first kind, pi / (2 AGM(1, b/a))), a wall of thickness t in series

f-holes-conductance.formula: K = 2 C(fLength / 2, fWidth / 2, fThickness): a body's two f-holes, each an elliptic aperture its length by its least width through the top about it

body-air-volume.formula: V = body (upper + middle + lower) / 3 (ribs + (archTop + archBack) / 2): the outline, its length by its three widths' mean, over the ribs' height and half of each arching, a dome's
body-air-volume.statistic: ours: a body's shape as a box with domes, its walls, f-holes' wings and outline's shape left out alike

fingerboard-end-semitones.formula: 12 log2(string / (string - fingerboard)): where the string meets the fingerboard's end, in semitones over the open string

helmholtz-ratio.formula: sqrt((K / V) / (K0 / V0)): a Helmholtz resonator's frequency over another's (f = c / 2pi sqrt(K / V)), each its conductance over its volume

inputs.V: volume, in the conductance's length cubed

lowest-hz.formula: f = a4 2^((min(tuning) - 69) / 12): an instrument's lowest open string's frequency

loss-table.formula: each of a measured string's modes, its frequency n f0 sqrt(1 + B n^2) with its stiffness (B = pi^3 E d^4 / (64 T L^2)) and its measured decay, its first `modes` of them: a string's losses by frequency, read between their points

table-read.formula: y at x in a table of [x, y] points: its first y below its first point, read in a line between the points about x, and past its last two by their line

string-loss-law.formula: r = r0 + r2 f^2: a string's mode's decay at its frequency
string-loss-law.statistic: ours: the form our fits gave the contrabass's losses (native/strings-model/string_tail.py --plucked)

scale-ratio.formula: a / a0: a quantity over the reference's

least-force-scale.formula: scale Z[0]^2 / mean(c0^2, c1^2, c2^2): a bow's force scale passed from another instrument's by Schelleng's least force, which grows as a string's wave impedance squared -- its lowest string's against the reference's lowest strings', each of its versions

inputs.Z: its strings' impedances, lowest first, kg/s
inputs.c0: the reference's lowest string's impedance, its version 0

periods-in.formula: n = seconds hz: how many periods of a frequency fit in a time

seconds-for.formula: t = max(least, periods / hz): a note's time to hold so many periods of its frequency, never under the least

finger-place.formula: x = 1 - 2^(-semitones / 12): the share of a string from its nut a finger stops to sound so many semitones over its open pitch (an ideal string's frequency goes as one over its sounding length)

log-grid.formula: x_k = least span^(k / (count - 1)), k = 0 .. count - 1: so many values evenly spaced in their logarithm from the least to the least times the span

semitones-ratio.formula: r = 2^(semitones / 12): the frequency ratio of an interval in equal-tempered semitones (fractional allowed)
semitones-ratio.statistic: a definition (twelve equal semitones to the octave)

ratio-semitones.formula: s = 12 log2(r): an interval's size in equal-tempered semitones from its frequency ratio

place-semitones.formula: s = -12 log2(1 - place): the semitones over its open pitch a finger sounds at this share of an ideal string from its nut (finger-place's inverse)

cents-semitones.statistic: a definition (a hundred cents to the equal-tempered semitone)

from-centi.formula: x = centi / 100: a quantity given in hundredths of its unit (cm, cm/s) in its unit

db-gain.formula: g = 10^(db / 20): an amplitude's ratio from its level's change in decibels

loss-ratio-for.formula: k = ln(10^(db / 20)) / (rate seconds): how many times its own loss rate (1/s) brings a decaying amplitude down db decibels in seconds

helmholtz-force-scale.formula: x = F beta / (2 Z v): a bow's force against the string's Helmholtz force at its contact and speed -- Schelleng's scale of bow force

inputs.contact: share of the string from the bridge

amplitude-db.formula: L = 20 log10(ratio): a ratio of amplitudes in decibels

likelihood-residual.formula: r = sqrt(max(0, -2 log p)): a probability's residual in a least-squares cost r^2 / 2, which is then its negative log-likelihood

power-db.formula: L = 10 log10(ratio): a ratio of powers in decibels

helmholtz-rise.formula: x = 2 Z v t / (beta T): the bridge force's rise under Helmholtz motion over a time t, its sawtooth climbing 2 Z v / beta each period T and falling as much at the flyback (t = T: the flyback's drop)

inputs.beta: share of the string from the bridge

semitones-octaves.formula: o = s / 12: an interval's octaves from its semitones
semitones-octaves.statistic: a definition (the semitone a twelfth of an octave)

golden-section.formula: g = (sqrt(5) - 1) / 2: the golden ratio's inverse, the share of its interval a golden-section search keeps each step

parabola-peak.formula: d = (a - c) / (2 (a - 2 b + c)) where a - 2 b + c < 0, else 0: the peak of the parabola through three equally spaced values a, b, c, as its offset from the middle one in spacings (none where it does not peak)

sawtooth.formula: x = 2 frac(f0 t) - 1: a sawtooth rising from -1 to 1 each period, falling back at once

cents-ratio.formula: r = 2^(cents / 1200): the frequency ratio of an interval in cents
cents-ratio.statistic: a definition (twelve hundred cents to the octave)

normal-deviate.formula: z = sqrt(-2 ln max(u, 1e-12)) cos(2 pi v): a standard normal deviate from two uniform ones in [0, 1) (u floored, so a draw of 0 gives a finite deviate)

hz-midi.formula: midi = 69 + 12 log2(f / a4): a frequency as a MIDI note, midi-hz's inverse

difference.formula: a - b: a quantity less another

scaled.formula: x a / b: a quantity scaled by a ratio

loss-per-frequency.formula: r2 = r1 (2 pi)^2 mu / T: a string's loss per squared wavenumber (its damping term 2 r1 rho A u_txx, m^2/s) as a loss per squared frequency, its modes at k = 2 pi f / c, c^2 = T / mu

friction-drop-scale.formula: k = (s0 - d0) / (s1 - d1): a bow's force measured under one friction (static s0, dynamic d0) moved to another (s1, d1) -- both of Schelleng's bounds on the force, the most and the least, go as one over the drop from static to dynamic friction, so the force keeps its place between them

inputs.s0: the static coefficient it was measured under

power-law.statistic: a power law: the Wood Handbook's modulus from specific gravity (Table 5-11a) is one
